verdict.rationale: Nix is a package manager and build system, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair thing to ask of its ecosystem and the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only the CLI, flakes, development shells and rollbacks, with no mention of MCP. Probes for agent-facing surfaces (llms.txt, markdown docs, OpenAPI) all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
